PAR2 parser test fixtures
=========================

Data files are deterministic (LCG byte stream), generated by:

  python3 -c "
  def gen(n, seed):
      out = bytearray()
      x = seed
      while len(out) < n:
          x = (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff
          out.append((x >> 16) & 0xff)
      return bytes(out[:n])
  open('alpha.bin','wb').write(gen(10240, 1))
  open('beta.bin','wb').write(gen(33792, 2))
  "

PAR2 files created with par2cmdline 1.2.0 (Homebrew, macOS):

  par2 create -s4096 -r34 -n1 -a testset alpha.bin beta.bin

Which reports:
  Block size: 4096
  Source file count: 2
  Source block count: 12   (alpha: 3 blocks, beta: 9 blocks)
  Recovery block count: 4  (all in testset.vol0+4.par2)
  Recovery file count: 1

Known reference values (verified against the FileDesc packets):
  alpha.bin  len 10240  md5 79fb73dfddd5c6d8551179759bf1f9a6
             md5-16k    79fb73dfddd5c6d8551179759bf1f9a6  (== whole-file md5:
             par2cmdline hashes min(len, 16384) bytes, NO zero padding)
  beta.bin   len 33792  md5 a8d2138aa232ae6b69214e334e12638a
             md5-16k    2a872f94918205439d8f6f01892d74b9
